name: Factorial HR
description: Manage company HR data with Factorial: inspect employees, organizational teams, leave requests, and attendance shifts.
instructions:
Manage company HR data with Factorial: inspect employees, organizational teams, time-off/leave requests, and attendance shifts.

**Authentication**:
1. Sign in to your Factorial workspace at https://app.factorialhr.com (or demo at https://app.demo.factorial.dev).
2. Navigate to **Settings → API Keys**.
3. Generate a company API key and copy it immediately.
4. Set the `FACTORIAL_API_KEY` environment variable. Calls are authenticated via the `x-api-key` header.

**Identifiers**:
- Employee IDs: numeric strings or integers identifying an employee (e.g. "123456").
- Team IDs: numeric strings identifying a team or department (e.g. "4567").
- Leave IDs: numeric strings identifying a time-off request (e.g. "78901").
- Shift IDs: numeric strings identifying an attendance record (e.g. "89012").

**Pagination and limits**:
- Cursor-based pagination using `limit`, `after_id`, and `before_id`.
- The maximum and default page size is 100 items per request; list tools default to `limit: 20` for concise responses.
- Responses contain a `meta` object with `has_next_page`, `end_cursor`, `has_previous_page`, and `start_cursor` alongside the `data` array.
- To fetch the next page, pass `after_id = meta.end_cursor` from the previous page while `meta.has_next_page` is true.

**Common workflows**:
1. **Find an employee and check profile**: Call `factorial_hr_list_employees` with `full_text_name` or `only_active: true`, then call `factorial_hr_get_employee` with the returned employee `id`.
2. **Review team structure**: Call `factorial_hr_list_teams` to list departments and managers, then list employees filtering by `team_ids`.
3. **Audit attendance and leave**: Call `factorial_hr_list_leaves` for an employee's requested time-off, and call `factorial_hr_list_shifts` to inspect clocked shifts in a date range.

**Limitations**:
- Read-only connector: write, update, and delete actions are not supported.
- Requires company-wide API key with appropriate permissions (some employee fields depend on admin privileges).

FACTORIAL_API_KEY.label: API key
FACTORIAL_API_KEY.help: Factorial, Settings > API Keys: generate an API key and copy it.
FACTORIAL_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the API key generated in Factorial Settings > API Keys.

verifyHints.401: Invalid or revoked Factorial API key. Generate a new key in Factorial under Settings > API Keys.
verifyHints.403: Forbidden. Your Factorial API key lacks permission to access this resource.
verifyHints.429: Rate limit exceeded. Factorial allows up to 100 requests per minute.

tools.name: factorial_hr_list_employees
tools.description: List company employees with directory details, contact information, role, and active status. Filter by name, email, team, manager status, or active employment. Paginate with after_id = meta.end_cursor while meta.has_next_page is true. Read-only.

limit.description: Number of employees to return per page (default 20, maximum 100).

after_id.description: Cursor pointer to fetch records after this cursor (pass meta.end_cursor from previous page).

before_id.description: Cursor pointer to fetch records before this cursor (pass meta.start_cursor from previous page).

only_active.description: Set to true to return only active employees not terminated as of today.

only_managers.description: Set to true to return only employees who have at least one direct report.

full_text_name.description: Filter employees by searching for full or partial name.

name_starts_with.description: Filter employees whose first or last name starts with the given prefix.

ids.description: Filter employees by one or more specific employee IDs.

emails.description: Filter employees by one or more email addresses.

team_ids.description: Filter employees by one or more team IDs they belong to.

tools.name: factorial_hr_get_employee
tools.description: Retrieve detailed profile, personal information, contract details, and role for a single employee by their ID. Read-only.

id.description: The unique identifier of the employee to retrieve.

tools.name: factorial_hr_list_teams
tools.description: List company teams, departments, and organizational units with leader and parent team hierarchy. Filter by team IDs. Paginate with after_id = meta.end_cursor while meta.has_next_page is true. Read-only.

limit.description: Number of teams to return per page (default 20, maximum 100).

after_id.description: Cursor pointer to fetch records after this cursor (pass meta.end_cursor from previous page).

before_id.description: Cursor pointer to fetch records before this cursor (pass meta.start_cursor from previous page).

ids.description: Filter by one or more specific team IDs.

tools.name: factorial_hr_list_leaves
tools.description: List employee time-off and leave requests with approval status, date ranges, and leave type. Set include_duration to request duration details and include_duration_by_day for the per-day breakdown (detailed fields are only populated when the corresponding option is requested). Filter by employee IDs, date window, or approval. Paginate with after_id = meta.end_cursor while meta.has_next_page is true. Read-only.

limit.description: Number of leave records to return per page (default 20, maximum 100).

after_id.description: Cursor pointer to fetch records after this cursor (pass meta.end_cursor from previous page).

before_id.description: Cursor pointer to fetch records before this cursor (pass meta.start_cursor from previous page).

employee_ids.description: Filter leaves by one or more employee IDs.

ids.description: Filter leaves by one or more specific leave IDs.

from.description: Filter leaves starting on or after this date (format YYYY-MM-DD).

to.description: Filter leaves ending on or before this date (format YYYY-MM-DD).

approved.description: Filter leaves by approval status (true for approved, false for unapproved/pending).

only_active.description: Set to true to exclude leaves belonging to terminated employees.

include_deleted_leaves.description: Whether to include deleted leaves (not included by default if not specified).

include_duration.description: Set to true to request duration information (duration_attributes, days_taken, hours_amount_in_cents). Detailed fields are only populated when requested.

include_duration_by_day.description: Set to true to request the per-day duration breakdown (duration_by_day_attributes). Detailed fields are only populated when requested.

tools.name: factorial_hr_list_shifts
tools.description: List employee attendance clock-in and clock-out shifts with recorded hours and locations. Filter by employee IDs or date window. Paginate with after_id = meta.end_cursor while meta.has_next_page is true. Read-only.

limit.description: Number of shift records to return per page (default 20, maximum 100).

after_id.description: Cursor pointer to fetch records after this cursor (pass meta.end_cursor from previous page).

before_id.description: Cursor pointer to fetch records before this cursor (pass meta.start_cursor from previous page).

employee_ids.description: Filter attendance shifts by one or more employee IDs.

ids.description: Filter attendance shifts by one or more specific shift IDs.

start_on.description: Filter shifts starting on or after this date (format YYYY-MM-DD).

end_on.description: Filter shifts ending on or before this date (format YYYY-MM-DD).

half_day.description: Set to true to return only the shifts marked as covering half a day. Passing false has no effect.

sort_created_at_asc.description: Flag to sort attendance shifts by created_at in ascending order (default true).
